norn.definition: n. (Norse mythology) any of the three goddesses of destiny; identified with Anglo-Saxon Wyrd; similar to Greek Moirae and Roman Parcae
norn.translation: n. 诺恩(命运三女神之一)

norna.definition:
n. One of the three Fates, Past, Present, and Future. Their
   names were Urd, Verdandi, and Skuld.
n. A tutelary deity; a genius.
norna.translation: [女子名] 诺娜来源于日耳曼语, 含义是“命运三女神之一”(a Norn)

nornarceine.translation: [化] 羟基那可汀; 降那碎因

nornarcotine.translation: [医] 去甲那可丁, 降那可丁

nornidulin.translation:
[化] 降巢曲菌素
[医] 焦曲菌素, 焦?状菌素
